current.name: Providers and API synchronization core
current.validation_rule: Lots 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3 are maintainer validated. Only sub-lot 5.4 is now authorized. Codex must stop for maintainer audit before 5.5.

lot_5_4_approved_concepts.streams: Two persistent streams current/historical; historical carries recent_catchup and deep_history logical classes
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.current_window: Sliding current window from today minus 7 days by default, configurable, never forced back to January 1
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.historical: Recent catchup covers data before current window; deep history descends N-1 until confirmed empty season
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.year_rollover: Newly completed year enters recent catchup priority without losing deep-history progress
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.scheduler_weights: Global weighted round-robin current/recent/deep = 3/2/1 by default, configurable, unused capacity redistributed
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.work_unit: One bounded adapter-defined unit per scheduler turn; scheduler does not impose universal pagination
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.lease: Persistent PostgreSQL lease, 120 seconds default, heartbeat about 30 seconds
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.fencing: Monotonic lease generation/fencing token required; stale workers cannot commit
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.workers: Global worker pool 4 by default plus provider max_concurrency 1 by default
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.atomicity: Durable synthetic result, cursor, stream state and run outcome commit atomically; failure rolls all back
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.sync_now: Temporary 15-minute priority boost, removed after first successful unit or expiry, never bypasses safety gates
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.reset: Explicit audited current/historical reset separately; never deletes stored business data
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.disable: Disabling a championship removes public publication and stops synchronization but retains all data and cursors
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.reactivate: Reactivation republishes eligible data, recalculates current sliding window, resumes historical progress and boosts current
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.crash_recovery: Expired lease recovered, previous run marked interrupted, resume at last committed cursor, stale worker fenced
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.error_boundary: 5.4 implements generic states/counters/suspension; exact 429 Retry-After exponential backoff jitter policy remains 5.5
lot_5_4_approved_concepts.periodic_discovery: 5.4 provides the single persistent scheduler integration for discovery eligibility created in 5.3

next_action.task: Audit and validate sub-lot 5.4. No Lot 5.5 implementation is authorized.
